events.title: Macbeth – Shake & Stir Theatre Co
events.description: Shake & Stir Theatre Co presents a modern, clickbait-inspired take on Shakespeare's gripping tragedy, Macbeth. This theatrical production runs until June 21st at QPAC's Playhouse.

events.title: Beetlejuice The Musical
events.description: Based on Tim Burton's film, this musical follows Lydia Deetz, a unique teenager who encounters a recently deceased couple and a mischievous demon. Performances run through early August at the Lyric Theatre.

events.title: Chris Botti – Live in Concert
events.description: Experience an intimate and atmospheric live performance by Chris Botti, one of the world's best-selling jazz trumpet artists. He performs at the Brisbane Powerhouse for one night only.

events.title: loscil – Live
events.description: Canadian ambient/electronic artist loscil (Scott Morgan) brings his meditative, drone-influenced soundscapes to the Institute of Modern Art. This performance offers a unique sonic experience in an artistic setting.

events.title: Against the Grain – Open Season Live Music Festival
events.description: Part of the Open Season festival, Against The Grain features a major lineup of indie and alternative acts including Stereolab, Pond, and Rolling Blackouts Coastal Fever. Enjoy a day of live music in the Clarence Corner precinct.

events.title: Ubuntu Social – Brisbane Powerhouse
events.description: A free, all-ages community festival celebrating world music, art, and connection, rooted in the philosophy of Ubuntu. The event showcases Brisbane's vibrant creative scene with various cultural performances and activities.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: The prestigious World Press Photo Exhibition returns with a powerful and thought-provoking selection of the year's best photojournalism. Explore global issues and human stories through stunning photography.

events.title: Queensland Ballet: Hamlet
events.location: Talbot Theatre, Thomas Dixon Centre, West End
events.description: Queensland Ballet presents a gripping dance drama interpretation of Shakespeare's Hamlet, choreographed by Leo Mujić. Experience the classic tragedy of love, power, and corruption through movement.

events.title: Opera Queensland: Rusalka
events.location: QPAC (Lyric Theatre / Concert Hall), South Brisbane
events.description: Inspired by The Little Mermaid, this fairytale opera tells the story of the water nymph Rusalka who seeks true freedom. Dvořák's score brings sweeping romance and folk music to this performance.

events.title: Assembly 2026 – La Boite Theatre
events.location: Roundhouse Theatre, La Boite, Kelvin Grove
events.description: Experience a snapshot of Brisbane's emerging theatrical talent with short, 10-minute pieces developed through mentorship. Assembly showcases the city's newest voices in an intimate theatre setting.

events.title: Building Digital Platform Observatories – UQ Workshop
events.description: This workshop gathers international researchers to discuss the importance of digital platform observatories for public accountability and governance of automated systems. Registration is required for participation.

events.title: State Library of Queensland Tours
events.location: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
events.description: Join volunteer guides for a free tour of the State Library, exploring its architecture, collections, services, and current exhibitions. Tours are customisable and run for approximately 45-60 minutes.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: GOMA offers extended gallery hours, special events, talks, and a social atmosphere every Friday evening. Enjoy contemporary art in a vibrant setting until late.

events.title: Anywhere Festival – Various Performances
events.description: This festival transforms unexpected Brisbane locations into stages for theatre, circus, music, and storytelling. Discover unique and intimate performances in non-traditional spaces.

events.title: Camerata: Revolution Remixed
events.location: Brisbane (check Camerata website for exact venue)
events.description: Camerata – Queensland's Chamber Orchestra reimagines classical masterpieces, including Beethoven's 'Eroica' Symphony and Mussorgsky's 'Pictures at an Exhibition'. Experience dynamic chamber performance with precision and passion.

events.title: QSO: Dvořák Cello Concerto / Beethoven Symphony No.7
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra performs Dvořák's radiant Cello Concerto, Beethoven's iconic Symphony No.7, and Smetana's Bartered Bride Overture. Enjoy an evening of classical music with a full orchestra.

events.title: Performance at Conservatorium Theatre (15 June)
events.description: Experience a 'magical and arresting' performance praised for its 'brilliance, charisma and sensitivity' at the Conservatorium Theatre. This event promises an evening of high-quality artistic expression.
